title: Tries of the Lower-Tier Alternative: Credit on Tier Exception Approvals (Formulary Benefit)
content:
**Credit.** Under the Formulary Benefit, a preferred-alternative trial credit is added to a tier exception approval for tries of the lower-tier formulary alternative in the drug's class. For a triple-therapy inhaler, that alternative is Trelegy Ellipta. The member's paid retail fills of the alternative are read from the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit claims, within the preferred-trial lookback of **12** months. A fill is within the lookback when its date of service lies fewer whole months than 12 before the decision date.

| Paid retail fills of the lower-tier alternative within the lookback | Credit added |
|---|---|
| two or more | **2** months |
| exactly one | **1** month |
| none | nothing |

The credit is added to the tier approval period before the floor of one month is applied.

*Hypothetical.* A member asking for a tier exception for a triple-therapy inhaler has three paid retail fills of Trelegy Ellipta in the past year. The credit is 2 months. With a single fill it is 1 month. A fill whose date of service is 12 whole months before the decision date does not count.
